title: tier-2 shipped code: the collider's unusable-triangle test at 0x142cd56e0
notes: SHIPPED-CODE tier-2 unit. The candidate is crates/ow-sim/src/collide.rs (triangle_degenerate), called by crates/ow-sim/src/bin/verify_probe.rs through the triangle_degenerate entry.

The leaf writes only AL, so the compared channel is one bit: 1 when the triangle must be skipped, 0 when it is usable. The MOVMSKPS result on the non-finite exit is overwritten by `mov al, 1` before the return, so no mask reaches the caller (the first differential iteration proved that: the candidate's mask 4 against the oracle's 1).

The four tests are ordered: a corner lane whose exponent is all ones (inf or NaN, low three lanes only), a bounding-box extent above 1e6 on any axis, an edge whose squared length is below 6.25e-6, and twice the area below 2.5e-5. The fixture's declared cases sit on both sides of every threshold.
The leaf reads three constant pools and nothing else, so allowedImageReads covers 0x1435ecfe0 (6.25e-6 and 2.5e-5), 0x142f841e8 (1e6) and 0x143083290 (the inf splat, read as two quads).
acknowledgedGaps: This unit verifies the degenerate-triangle predicate only. Its two callers - the sector build inside 0x142cca460 and the brush path - are unread, so the predicate's role in the collider pipeline is not exercised here.
